survey: An open paper envelope, seen almost straight on and tilted slightly. The back flap stands open behind the contents, and its tip shows above the photos. Four photo cards stand in a fanned stack inside the pocket. Their lower parts are hidden behind the front panel, so they rest inside the envelope. The front panel has the usual folded side and bottom flaps, with diagonal seams meeting below the centre, and the folds look consistent. A scalloped postage stamp sits flat on the upper right of the panel. The circular postmark and its wavy cancel lines are printed flat on the paper next to it. Ellipse fits E1–E4 have width ratios of 0.99–1.00 and stay within 1.5% of a true ellipse, as expected for a flat print seen face-on. There are no cables or thin parts with loose ends. Every part is contained in or printed on the envelope, nothing floats, and the envelope could hold the photos.
